plugins.name: fz
plugins.description: AI development workflow orchestration: natural language → skill pipeline → multi-agent team → execution

plugins.name: fz-compact
plugins.description: Optional fz add-on: local masking compaction for background sessions after the prompt cache goes cold. No model calls. Off until enabled.

plugins.name: fz-guard
plugins.description: Optional fz add-on: hooks that enforce Phase 4 approval after /fz (writing Bash included), confirm ad-hoc agents in fz sessions, ask for a registry entry when a turn writes an fz lesson to memory, and ask for the GPT review in fz-review turns while blocking the retired model name in fz plugin files. Opt-in: asks before Bash that runs under configured protected paths. Fails open. Off until installed.
